_schema.description: Other sites' statewide poll averages, for the polls page's comparison table. Figures, dates and links only. This site's own poll of polls isn't stored here: the page computes it from polls.json.

fields.updated: When this file's figures last changed (UTC)
fields.aggregates[]: One per outside average: id, name, publisher, url (the page), data_url (the file read), credit, licence, cadence (every_refresh or daily)
fields.aggregates[].primary: Primary vote % by party code (ALP, LNP = Coalition, GRN, ONP, OTH = all others); a party the source doesn't publish is absent
fields.aggregates[].tpp: Two-party preferred % {ALP, LNP}, or null when the source publishes none
fields.aggregates[].as_of: The date the estimate runs to (YYYY-MM-DD): electiontracker.au's as_of (its newest poll's fieldwork end), the newest poll in BludgerTrack's trend (fieldwork midpoint), and the day Ace Strategies last updated its page
fields.aggregates[].published: When the source last updated its figures (its own timestamp)
fields.aggregates[].polls_included: How many polls the average uses, where the source lists them
fields.aggregates[].checked: Melbourne date the figures were last read successfully
fields.aggregates[].tpp_note: Why tpp is null, in a few words
